title: Glowing paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='42' ry='34' fill='#2a1a4a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- palette body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='28' fill='#d4a056'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='28' fill='none' stroke='#f0c878' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='9' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#f0c878' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- paint blobs -->
  <!-- red -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='7' fill='#ff3344'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff8899'/>
  <!-- orange -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='6.5' fill='#ff8800'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ffcc66'/>
  <!-- yellow -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='6.5' fill='#ffe000'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='2' fill='#fff7aa'/>
  <!-- green -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='6' fill='#33cc44'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='2' fill='#99ee99'/>
  <!-- blue -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='6' fill='#3388ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='62' r='2' fill='#99ccff'/>
  <!-- purple -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='68' r='5.5' fill='#aa44ff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='66' r='1.8' fill='#dd99ff'/>
  <!-- paintbrush handle -->
  <rect x='52' y='8' width='5' height='28' rx='2' fill='#c87a30' transform='rotate(12 54 20)'/>
  <!-- ferrule -->
  <rect x='51' y='30' width='7' height='6' rx='1' fill='#c0c8d8' transform='rotate(12 54 33)'/>
  <!-- brush tip with paint -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='42' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#ff3344' transform='rotate(12 63 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='39' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ff8899' transform='rotate(12 61 39)'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#fff7aa'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#fff7aa'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='65' r='1.2' fill='#99ccff'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#99ee99'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#ffcc66'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='75' r='1' fill='#dd99ff'/>
</svg>
